statement: Macrofy is a product centred on macronutrients (protein, carbohydrate, fat). The owner will define who it serves and what it does; until then the mission is a draft and only foundations are built.

goals.title: Trustworthy delivery
goals.measure: mc check passes on every commit to main, and every done task carries verify evidence (plus an accepting review when required) in the journal

constraints: Isolated from Artisan Studio: no shared dependencies, build config or source files
The harness stays dependency-free (Node 18+ built-ins only) so any agent or CI can run it
